description: Find DOJ equitable-sharing agencies in one state or territory by agency-name substring or ORI. Returns DOJ database status and sharing labels, matched DOJ payments by federal fiscal year, and the agency's ESAC certifications by its own fiscal year with DOJ and Treasury as separate money fields. DOJ payment years and agency certification years must never be added, subtracted or treated as a gap. A certified balance is not misconduct. DOJ does not publish why an agency has a Non-Compliant or Ineligible status. A payment, review or audit finding does not establish unlawful conduct. Controlled-equipment entries itemise purchases already in ESAC spending categories and must never be added again. A seizure is not a crime or conviction. The newest ESAC year is partial; older thin years are marked in the response. Agency names are DOJ's; officials and other people are never named.

agency.description: Optional case-insensitive agency name substring or exact ORI, at most 80 characters.

state.description: Required two-letter state or territory code in the register index.
